question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_payment_with_tiebreaker AS (
    SELECT 
        fpc.customer_id,
        fpc.first_payment_date,
        p.payment_id,
        p.rental_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fpc.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date, p.payment_id) as rn
    FROM payment p
    JOIN first_payment_per_customer fpc ON p.customer_id = fpc.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fpc.first_payment_date
),
first_payment_record AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id
    FROM first_payment_with_tiebreaker
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.customer_id,
        p.rental_id
    FROM first_payment_record fp
    JOIN payment p ON p.payment_id = fp.payment_id
),
first_movie_details AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = fr.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals,
        SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fmd.rating,
    COUNT(*) as num_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_amount), 2) as avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1), 2) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_details fmd
JOIN customer_stats cs ON cs.customer_id = fmd.customer_id
GROUP BY fmd.rating
ORDER BY fmd.rating
